SELECT co.id, co.course_id, c.id AS course_no, c.title AS course_name, c.credits AS credit, co.semester_id, s.name AS semester_name, co.teacher_id, u.name AS teacher_name, co.max_students FROM course_offerings co INNER JOIN courses c ON co.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id INNER JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id INNER JOIN users u ON t.id = u.id
ORDER BY co.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM course_offerings co INNER JOIN courses c ON co.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id INNER JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id INNER JOIN users u ON t.id = u.id
